articles.title: Navigating NEMA Air Quality Regulations: A Guide for Industrial Plant Managers
articles.summary: An executive breakdown of the Environmental Management and Co-ordination (Air Quality) Regulations, stack sampling thresholds, and best practices for emission compliance.
articles.content: Industrial facility managers in Kenya face stringent compliance requirements under the EMCA (Air Quality) Regulations 2014. From mandatory quarterly stack testing on boilers and kilns to fenceline ambient PM2.5/PM10 monitoring, this article outlines the core methodologies (USEPA Methods 1-5), isokinetic sampling principles, and how to prepare audit-ready records for NEMA inspections.
articles.author: Dr. Principal Air Quality Specialist

articles.title: The Critical Role of Geotechnical Soil Investigation in Urban Infrastructure
articles.summary: Why Standard Penetration Testing (SPT), rotary core drilling, and settlement calculations are vital before laying commercial foundation slabs.
articles.content: With Nairobi and East African cities experiencing unprecedented vertical construction, accurate subsurface geotechnical investigation is not merely a formality—it is a critical structural safeguard. We examine how variable volcanic phonolite formations, localized clay pockets, and groundwater fluctuations impact bearing capacity and pile foundation engineering.
articles.author: Senior Geotechnical Engineer

articles.title: Occupational Noise Exposure & DOSHS Standards in Manufacturing Facilities
articles.summary: Practical strategies to mitigate hearing hazards, perform personal noise dosimetry, and comply with the Occupational Safety and Health Act (OSHA 2007).
articles.content: Prolonged exposure to sound levels exceeding 85 dBA across an 8-hour Time-Weighted Average (TWA) poses acute sensory risks and legal liability. This guide walks through Class 1 acoustic field measurements, octave band analysis for targeted machine dampening, and establishing an effective Hearing Conservation Program in compliance with DOSHS.
articles.author: Eng. Senior Lead Consultant
